title: Data transfer center
subtitle: Download a template, upload your completed file, map the columns and run the import.

rules.title: Template rules
rules.headers: Do not change the headers; if you do, map those columns manually in the column mapping step.
rules.deleteColumns: You can delete columns you don't need; data in deleted columns is left unchanged.
rules.dates: Write dates as DD.MM.YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 01.06.2026); textual dates are not accepted.
rules.lookups: Option values as well as unit and manager values must already exist in the system.
rules.matching: Employees are matched by National ID + First name + Last name.

templates.downloadError: The template could not be downloaded.

upload.dropHint: Drag the file here or click to choose
upload.invalidType: Only .xlsx or .csv files can be uploaded.
upload.tooLarge: The file size cannot exceed 10 MB.
upload.error: The file could not be uploaded.

options.title: Options

updateOnlyHelp.noMatchError: Rows that don't match an existing record are reported as errors.
updateOnlyHelp.mappedOnly: Only mapped columns are written; empty cells leave existing data unchanged.

options.updateOnlyUnsupported: This template does not support update only mode.

failurePolicy.SkipInvalidRowsHelp: Valid rows are imported; invalid rows are reported in the result file.
failurePolicy.AllOrNothingHelp: If any row is invalid, nothing is imported.

run.noPermission: You don't have permission to run imports.

result.failedAllOrNothingHint: Because “All or nothing” was selected, no records were imported.
result.downloadError: The result file could not be downloaded.
result.rowsLoadError: Row results could not be loaded.

job.loadError: The import job could not be loaded.

errorCodes.IMPORT_NO_MATCH: No matching record found (update only mode does not create new records).
errorCodes.IMPORT_NAME_MISMATCH: The national ID matched, but the first or last name differs from the existing record.
errorCodes.IMPORT_DUPLICATE_ROW: The same national ID appears in more than one row of the file.
errorCodes.IMPORT_INVALID_DATE: Invalid date; use DD.MM.YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY.
errorCodes.IMPORT_LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND: The value is not defined in the system; create the related record first.
